raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Allow AMD ROCm Hyperloom contributors `chaojhou`, `haishuok0525`, and `siliangchen-amd`, and paged-experts contributor `N3mezis` (Jan Schalkamp), to manage CI for their contributions without waiting for a maintainer to add the `run-ci` label.

## Modifications

Add four `custom override` entries in `.github/CI_PERMISSIONS.json`, enabling CI labeling and failed-CI reruns with a 60-minute cooldown. Existing entries are unchanged.

## Validation

- Parsed the JSON and verified that exactly these four entries were added.
- Ran `.github/update_ci_permission.py --sort-only` and checked alphabetical ordering.
- Configuration only; no runtime code or model behavior changes.

<!-- pr-states:start -->
---
